cards.title: Keep dictation audio off by default
cards.sourceStatus: The source change exists in the archived Mac app; it moves with the Mac app port.
cards.outcome: A fresh install keeps no recordings unless the user chooses to retain them.
checks: Fresh preferences show retention off without saving an invented choice.
Existing saved choices survive a restart.
Confirm recording cleanup on a Mac.

cards.title: Write the first-run guide
cards.outcome: A new person can open Open Convo and understand what it does and what stays on their device.
checks: The guide uses plain wording first.
It names what is simulated in the preview.
notes: A guide does not authorize a public release.

cards.title: Close the port review findings
cards.sourceStatus: The Desk port is waiting for an independent review.
cards.outcome: Each review finding has a fix or an explicit disposition.
checks: An independent reviewer checks the port for private material and broken behavior.
Findings are fixed or dispositioned in the move log.
notes: A passing earlier review does not approve new code.

cards.title: Open saved sessions read-only
cards.sourceStatus: A local read-only reader is built and tested with invented records. Hosted access is disabled.
cards.outcome: A read-only local reader shows saved sessions without rewriting, migrating or uploading them.
checks: Prove the reader with invented records, including damaged and older formats.
The original file is unchanged after reading.
notes: Reading a file never sends it to a model.

cards.title: Make Navigator useful for real session lists
cards.sourceStatus: Sample controls include pins, rename, folder and session details. Search and sorting remain planned.
cards.outcome: Find a session by title or content, rename or pin it, and organize it in domains without duplicating the conversation.
checks: Renames and pins preserve record identities, drafts and creation times.
Restore recency sorting and title/content search.
A session can be linked into more than one folder without copying its messages.
notes: Folder placement does not change data permissions.

cards.title: Restore the agreed conversation feel
cards.sourceStatus: The preview still uses per-message identity rows.
cards.outcome: The conversation is the main view: one continuous chat, light user bubbles, a compact composer and readable replies.
checks: Enter sends while multiline entry and drafts are preserved.
Add copy controls and readable formatting, including tables.
notes: Try changes on invented conversations first.

cards.title: Bring back Related and Revisit when
cards.sourceStatus: Not connected to the current UI.
cards.outcome: Find a related older session and set a visible reminder to return to it.
checks: Related lookup obeys the selected local scope.
Revisit reminders survive a restart and can be edited or removed.
notes: Old passing tests do not prove a capability works in the new UI.

cards.title: Make saves and recovery hold up
cards.sourceStatus: Browser sample saves use transactions. Native durable saving is planned.
cards.outcome: Long histories, drafts and interrupted runs survive restart, disk failure and competing edits without silent loss.
checks: Test interrupted writes, full and read-only storage, stale edits and damaged stores.
Prove a recovery drill on a tested copy before real use.
notes: Moving a roadmap card is not evidence that save checks passed.

cards.title: Protect private history before live use
cards.sourceStatus: Planned. The browser sample workspace is unencrypted.
cards.outcome: Local protected storage, lock, permissions and deletion are tested before private history becomes assistant context.
checks: Check locking, wrong keys, restart and withdrawn access with invented records.
Show what a model would receive before Send.
notes: Real private history requires protected native storage.

cards.title: Have one real conversation that saves and returns
cards.sourceStatus: Replies are simulated; no model is connected.
cards.outcome: Use one approved model route, see its reply arrive, stop it if needed, and return later without retelling the session.
checks: Choose the approved route and its cost boundary when this step begins.
Test streaming, Stop, safe retry and typing during a reply.
notes: Subscription access is not permission for paid API use.

cards.title: Chosen memory and clarity controls
cards.sourceStatus: Invented-data remember, correct, forget, restore and Undo controls are built. The clarity library lives in packages/clarity.
cards.outcome: Keep, correct or forget selected memory under user control, with the clarity controls built in.
checks: Keep only material the user marks; prove exclusions across summaries and search.
Connect the Wait—what? and clarity correction controls from packages/clarity.
notes: Saving a memory does not authorize wider or cloud use.

cards.title: Canvas connections and the Atlas knowledge view
cards.sourceStatus: Canvas shows sample relationships; Atlas is planned.
cards.outcome: Canvas connects domains, sessions, ideas and work; Atlas offers a separate knowledge view.
checks: Navigator and Canvas share record identities.
Prove Atlas with invented records before any real data.
notes: A relationship map does not infer links on its own.

cards.title: Bring several agents into one session
cards.sourceStatus: The shared inbox and reported job status are built with invented data. Live agent connections remain.
cards.outcome: Several agents work from one session with visible responsibility and separately approved routes.
checks: Show which agent acts next and which model did what.
Start with one Plan pilot that returns a saved plan and stops for review.
notes: Selecting Publish does not authorize sending or release.
